cues: A repairer presses a blade into a slotted head and twists until the screw bites into timber.
During disassembly, repeated counterclockwise rotations back a tiny screw out of a camera casing.
Technicians use a torque-limited handle to seat delicate screws without stripping their heads.
Rainwater gathered in shallow stone basins before trickling through the garden’s narrow channels.
The violinist tuned each string carefully before the orchestra began its evening rehearsal.
A colony of penguins huddled together against gusts sweeping across the icy shore.
